record.bible_text: Praise<WH01984><WTH8761> ye the LORD<WH03050>: for <FI>it is<Fi> good<WH02896> to sing praises<WH02167><WTH8763> unto our God<WH0430>; for <FI>it is<Fi> pleasant<WH05273>; <FI>and<Fi> praise<WH08416> is comely<WH05000>.
